category_title: Middle school students with LD exhibiting low engagement and poor material management
scenario_title: Managing materials and engagement during math instruction
minimal_context: Chris is sitting in his 50-minute math class with the goal of acquiring new math concepts.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Chris, it is time to start our 50-minute math class. Please get out your pencil, paper, and math book so we can begin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drawing pictures) I don't have my pencil, paper, or math book today.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop drawing and pay attention to the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Math is just not my subject. Watch this, I'm going to draw something funny to show the other students.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look up here at the board and try to follow along with the concepts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues doodling, not looking at the teacher) I know that when I listen more I get it more easily, but I'm just going to keep drawing.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Chris, it is time to start our 50-minute math class. Please get out your pencil, paper, and math book so we can begin.

STUDENT: (Drawing pictures) I don't have my pencil, paper, or math book today.

TUTOR: You need to stop drawing and pay attention to the lesson.

STUDENT: Math is just not my subject. Watch this, I'm going to draw something funny to show the other students.

TUTOR: Please look up here at the board and try to follow along with the concepts.

STUDENT: (Continues doodling, not looking at the teacher) I know that when I listen more I get it more easily, but I'm just going to keep drawing.

task.content: Acquiring important concepts in class during a 50-min math class period
task.learning_goal: Improve his math performance by targeting preparedness to learn and on-task behavior

context.environment: 50-min math class period in a middle school
context.materials: Pencil, paper, math book, MARS checklist, MARS template
context.social_setting: In-class assistance from the special education teacher in math class
context.time_context: Daily 50-min class period, with check-ins right before math class and check-outs later in the day during home room

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Arriving to math class not oriented to learning
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Drew pictures during class, liked to be thought of as one of the funny students, and was looking at or oriented toward the teacher only 1 of the 5 days (20%)
related_quotes: Math is just not my subject
When I listen more I get it more easily

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Off-task behavior, doodling (i.e., drew pictures during class), and not having pencil, paper, and math book
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Poor engagement not conducive to acquiring important concepts
